title: Verify: App intro gate unit tests
summary: Unit tests for App showing the intro first and dismissing it
description: Write game/frontend/tests/app.test.tsx covering the intro gate with jsdom and the real components; localStorage is jsdom's and is cleared by tests/setup.ts.
acceptance_criteria: Given fresh render, the intro text and Begin button show with no hotspots
Given Begin clicked, the intro is gone

steps.action: Create the file with '// @vitest-environment jsdom', imports of render/screen/fireEvent/cleanup from @testing-library/react and App from '../src/App'. Add describe('App intro gate') with afterEach(cleanup) and test 'Given a fresh render, then the intro and Begin button show and no hotspot exists': render(<App />), assert screen.getByText('What should I do?') and screen.getByRole('button',{name:'Begin'}) are in the document and screen.queryByRole('button',{name:'Bed'}) is null.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/app.test.tsx -t 'intro gate'

steps.action: Add test 'Given Begin is clicked, then the intro is removed': render(<App />), fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button',{name:'Begin'})), assert screen.queryByText('What should I do?') is null.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/app.test.tsx -t 'intro is removed'
